description: Symbolic planning vocabulary. Every SkillSpec precondition and effect names a fact from this list, and the cognition process derives these facts from an Observation.

facts.crafting_table: crafting tables held or owned nearby
facts.safe: 1 when no immediate threat or hazard applies
facts.shelter_complete: 1 when the owned shelter is sealed
facts.shelter_known: 1 when an owned shelter exists, sealed or not
facts.home_known: 1 when an active home position is known
facts.at_home: 1 when standing at the active home
facts.furnace_placed: 1 when an owned furnace exists nearby
facts.permitted_container_nearby: count of pre-existing containers configuration allows withdrawing from
facts.reachable_wood: count of permitted wood resources in range
facts.reachable_stone: count of permitted stone resources in range
facts.reachable_coal: count of permitted coal resources in range
facts.reachable_plant_food: count of permitted plant food resources in range
facts.reachable_animal: count of permitted passive animal targets in range
facts.diggable_ground: 1 when an emergency refuge can be dug here
facts.hunting_permitted: 1 when configuration allows hunting unnamed untamed passive animals
facts.stored_surplus: 1 after a completed deposit into owned storage
facts.withdrawn: 1 after a completed withdrawal from owned storage
facts.looted: 1 after a completed withdrawal from a permitted pre-existing container
facts.surveyed: 1 when Person has looked around since it last had reason to
